title: Psycho Killer

As the hunt progresses, she comes to realize the man responsible is a sadistic serial killer, and the depth of his mental depravity and his sinister agenda is more twisted than anyone could have imagined. The killer's plan is a twisted one, and his actions are more brutal than anyone could have anticipated. The officer's determination to bring the killer to justice is unwavering, and she is driven by a fierce desire to see justice served.
